edge_baseline_yolov8n_224px.note: Lightweight edge baseline with ultra-low latency but lower accuracy (51.7% mAP50, crazing collapsed at 2.5% AP50).

selected_yolov8s_640px_dynamic_int8.analysis: Dynamic quantization reduced file size by 74.3% but caused a severe 5.8x slowdown and 11.6% mAP50 degradation due to runtime activation quantization and fallback to FP32 on 2D convolutions.

selected_yolov8s_640px_static_qdq_int8.quantization: Static QDQ INT8 (Conv quantized, FP32 detection head)
selected_yolov8s_640px_static_qdq_int8.analysis: Static QDQ quantization with calibration data bakes activation scales offline into Conv layers while preserving the detection head in FP32, preventing the 416ms dynamic slowdown and retaining 50.5% mAP50 with a 60.1% footprint reduction.
